AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1 (EASU + RCAS)

Used by: graphics/nvn/gfx/nvn/nvn_present_fsr.inc (the direct present's "Fsr" scaling filter; a Metal
Shading Language port of FsrEasuCon / FsrEasuSetF / FsrEasuTapF / FsrEasuF and FsrRcasCon / FsrRcasF and
of the APrxLoRcpF1 / APrxLoRsqF1 / APrxMedRcpF1 approximations) and graphics/nvn/tests/fsr1_ref.h (a C
port of the same formulas, the test reference).

Source: the AMD ffx_a.h / ffx_fsr1.h text embedded in the Ryujinx Vulkan effect shaders
compat/tree/src/Ryujinx.Graphics.Vulkan/Effects/Shaders/FsrScaling.glsl and FsrSharpening.glsl.
The two notices below are that text's own, verbatim (comment markers removed). Both are also embedded
at the top of the shader source string in nvn_present_fsr.inc, so they ship inside every binary that
contains the port.
